ceiling_directive: Construct a capacity-aware learner attaining the multiscale lower rate uniformly throughout the unsaturated strict sub-familywise region, thereby proving the exact regret rate and necessary-and-sufficient vanishing criterion.
improvement_directive: Prove a selected-mixture oracle inequality giving regret of order A[1+A^{κ/(1−κ)}] throughout the unresolved unsaturated region and use it to determine whether A→0 is sufficient. Then derive a matching maximal-width lower bound from the paired-splice hypercube and the exact confidence-width shrinking criterion.
critique: The note does not deliver the advertised full joint-sequence tail-mixture frontier. In the unsaturated growing-m region it leaves a gap between the lower rate A[1+A^{κ/(1−κ)}] and the coordinatewise upper rate min{ℓ, A[log(2m)]^κ}, so both the exact regret rate and the necessary-and-sufficient consistency criterion remain open; the matched many-cell regions have nonvanishing or saturated regret, while only m=2 is completely resolved in a vanishing regime. The inference result supplies an honest upper system and a sufficient shrinking condition but no width converse or exact shrinking criterion. The assertion that the “distributional lower-side obstruction is resolved” is too broad because the sharp-regret question expressly leaves open whether a harder same-class configuration raises the lower bound. These omissions leave the central sample-complexity boundary unsettled and make the package a specialized partial-frontier contribution rather than a field-level result. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 5.6 < 7.2, so the graded tier 'subfield' is capped at 'incremental'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
